items.title: Howmet Aerospace (HWM) Is Facing New Competition In Gas Turbine Blade Casting
items.summary: Howmet Aerospace (NYSE:HWM) faces new direct competition as SpaceX begins casting gas turbine blades in house. SpaceX is shifting from customer to rival in a key industrial process that underpins Howmet Aerospace’s core casting business. The move introduces a well funded and technically capable competitor into a specialized market that has historically relied on external suppliers. Investors are assessing how this change in supplier and customer relationships could affect Howmet’s future...

items.title: Is It Worth Investing in Howmet (HWM) Based on Wall Street's Bullish Views?
items.summary: Based on the average brokerage recommendation (ABR), Howmet (HWM) should be added to one's portfolio. Wall Street analysts' overly optimistic recommendations cast doubt on the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric. So, is the stock worth buying?
